scientific_scope_status: For a nested Bell-prefix source with hidden boundary K, B=E[K]ln D, H=H(K), and reliable net entanglement rate R in nats per queue, max{0,H-ln(H+1)-5.012468686862438} <= B-R <= H+4ln2. Hence (B-R)/H tends to one for every growing-entropy family of finite priors, including varying D, in the stated r-first order. Exact additive second-order loss remains open. A native GHZ case defeats a pointwise sharpening; a completed separable measurement defeats an averaged constant only in the separable relaxation. No LOCC implementation or capacity consequence is established; no clock record or free entangled aid is supplied.
